direction:
## Cover direction

**Color grading specialist:** Two options were compared. Option A put a pipeline route across the full width. Option B stacked six quiet surfaces with the step name aligned in one column. B won because the alignment is the concept. Beauty comes from a grey ramp across the six slabs and one red accent.

**Wayfinding designer:** One 2px red edge runs the full height of the canvas. Every instance of "Test api" starts against that edge, so the eye reads one name down six surfaces. The labels use the plan's own words: exit 1, attempt 1, line 214, 4 of 6.

**Camera operator:** The smallest change that breaks the frame is to let the slabs run off the right edge, which keeps the left margin clean for the title. Hidden cost: long suffixes would be clipped. Suffixes stay at two words or fewer.

**Amber crab:** Retry matters most, so the retry slab is the only navy surface. The skipped steps sit in the last slab as a sideways arrow with the same weight as the name.

**Lead's choice:**
- **Composition:** The title sits in a left block at 104px across three lines. On the right, six slabs are stacked at 84px each and bleed off the right edge. A single vertical red rule at x 946 aligns the name column.
- **Palette:** Background #111316 with slabs ramping from #181b1f to #262b32. Retry slab in navy #0E2A47. Text #e6e8eb, muted #9aa1aa. Red #BE4D4D for the edge, the failed glyph and the title's full stop.
- **Type:** Cover Headline for the title, Cover Text for everything else. Slab names are 32px with tabular numerals. Role labels are 11px tracked uppercase.
